index.description: The [fragment N] number from the prompt. Fragments are fixed; you may not add or reorder them.

title.description: The name of the thing this fragment defines or states, in the book's own words. Never a lead-in label such as 'Definition' or 'Remark 1'.

summary.description: What a learner must be able to do to have this skill. Drawn from the fragment text, not invented.

standalone.description: False means this fragment is a continuation of the one before it and should be folded into it. Folding is the only change to the segmentation you may request.
